question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:
A sudden and violent event causing great destruction
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cataclysm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Cataclysm"** means a sudden and violent event that causes great destruction or change. (प्रलय)
 
 
• **Example:** The earthquake was a cataclysm that devastated the entire region.
 
 
• The word **"Cataclysm"** signifies a disaster or upheaval of massive proportions, often leading to destruction and chaos. (प्रलय)
 
 
• **Example:** The volcanic eruption was a cataclysm that reshaped the landscape forever.
